en.text: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

footnotes.text: 149:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

en.text: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

zhSimplified.text: 愿因造他的主欢喜！ 的民因他们的王快乐！

zhTraditional.text: 願因造他的主歡喜！ 的民因他們的王快樂！

en.text: Let them praise his name in the dance! sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們跳舞讚美他的名，

en.text: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓；

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華喜愛他的百姓；

en.text: Let the saints rejoice in honor. them sing for joy on their beds.
May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们口中称赞 神为高，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們口中稱讚上帝為高，

en.text: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

zhSimplified.text: 要用链子捆他们的君王，

zhTraditional.text: 要用鍊子捆他們的君王，

en.text: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。

zhTraditional.text: 要在他們身上施行所記錄的審判。
